info.title: ponyllm-server
info.description: ponyllm gateway admin API. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <gateway-key>` or `x-api-key: <gateway-key>`. `?token=` query auth is deprecated: it leaks credentials into logs/bookmarks and is disabled in `strict` mode (P2); use header auth. Rotate: `POST /api/admin/auth/rotate` (200 one-time plaintext; 401 invalid key; 404 admin-write disabled; 409 open mode has no credential).

409.description: open mode has no credential to rotate (`open_mode_no_credential`)

post.summary: Hard-delete a gateway credential (2026-09-21 semantic change).
post.description:
`revoke` historically flipped `revoked=true` (soft delete); it now REMOVES
the entry from disk + memory and keeps NO record of it. A second delete of
the same id is therefore 404 (`gateway_key_not_found`), not 200 — there is
nothing left to be idempotent over. The deleted id may be re-issued later.

404.description: admin write channel disabled (`admin_write_disabled`) or unknown id (`gateway_key_not_found`)
OAuth state not found or expired

get.summary:
List models offered by the provider's upstream (`source: "quota"` for
Antigravity, `"upstream"` for OpenAI-style `/models`).
Providers without a listable interface answer 404 so the console can fall
back to manual entry with a toast instead of a picker modal.

get.description:
Default is pure in-memory (key state + cooldown from the live pools):
zero upstream calls, zero config writes. `refresh=true` additionally
probes Antigravity keys via the same egress-gated `fetch_quota` path as
the key dial-test; a probe failure degrades to `stale=true` memory state
instead of failing the request. Never emits key material.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description:
`true` = allow one Antigravity upstream quota probe per key
(15s built-in timeout, egress-gated, failure is silent `stale`).
Default `false` = pure in-memory, zero upstream calls.

GatewayKeyView.description:
Read-only projection of one scoped gateway credential.

Never contains the plaintext, the salt, or the hash — only the operator
identification fields (`prefix` + `last4`) plus lifecycle state.

IssueGatewayKeyResponse.description:
One-time issuance response: `api_key` is plaintext ONLY here (plus
`Cache-Control: no-store`); the server persists hash + salt + `last4`.

KeyCapacityEstimate.description: Dynamic capacity estimation and account tier inference

estimated_capacity_5h.description: Inferred 5-hour total capacity in tokens, if fitted

estimated_tokens_remaining_5h.description: Estimated remaining tokens in 5h window based on current remaining fraction

cooldown_remaining_secs.description: Seconds left in the current cooldown (only while `cooling_down`).

cooldown_reset_at.description:
Wall-clock instant the key is expected to recover, RFC 3339 UTC. Lets
the Web badge show the upstream-advertised quota reset verbatim.

input_price.description: Model-level price overrides (`None` inherits the provider baseline).

temperature.description: Model-level default sampling (`None` keeps the request value).

auth_compat.description:
Auth compatibility mode (`legacy-only|dual|strict`). Surfaced so the
console can warn before a `strict` switch locks out legacy-only clients.

cooldown_remaining_secs.description: Seconds left in the current cooldown (only while `cooling_down`).

cooldown_reset_at.description: Wall-clock instant the key is expected to recover, RFC 3339 UTC.

quota.description: Antigravity per-model remaining fractions (refresh hit only).

schedulable.description: Whether the key may receive traffic now (`None` = unknown/probe path).

source.description:
Quota signal lineage (v2 §4, frozen wording): `buckets` (antigravity
refresh hit) / `probe_only` (in-memory state+cooldown) / `unknown`.

stale.description: True when the refresh probe failed and only memory state is served.

oneOf.description: Measured rolling usage & inferred capacity metrics
